mapper.select: SELECT id, region, flag_key, description, enabled, rollout_percent, created_at FROM feature_flag WHERE region=#{region} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feature_flag(region, flag_key, description, enabled, rollout_percent) VALUES(#{region}, #{flagKey}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{rolloutPercent})
mapper.update: UPDATE feature_flag SET flag_key=#{flagKey}, description=#{description}, enabled=#{enabled}, rollout_percent=#{rolloutPercent}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region}
mapper.select: SELECT id,feature_flag_id,scope_type,scope_id,enabled,rollout_percent,created_at,updated_at FROM feature_flag_scope WHERE id=#{id} AND feature_flag_id=#{featureFlagId}

SELECT fs.id,fs.feature_flag_id,fs.scope_type,fs.scope_id,fs.enabled,fs.rollout_percent,fs.created_at,fs.updated_at FROM feature_flag_scope fs WHERE fs.feature_flag_id=#{featureFlagId} AND ( (fs.scope_type='campaign' AND fs.scope_id=#{campaignId}) OR (fs.scope_type='shop' AND fs.scope_id=#{shopId}) OR (fs.scope_type='city' AND fs.scope_id=(SELECT city_id FROM shop WHERE id=#{shopId})) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN fs.scope_type='campaign' THEN 1 WHEN fs.scope_type='shop' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE feature_flag_scope SET enabled=#{enabled},rollout_percent=#{rolloutPercent},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND feature_flag_id=#{featureFlagId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM feature_flag_scope WHERE id=#{id} AND feature_flag_id=#{featureFlagId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, region, name, flag_key, status, created_at FROM experiment WHERE region=#{region} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO experiment(region, name, flag_key, status) VALUES(#{region}, #{name}, #{flagKey}, #{status})
INSERT INTO experiment_assignment(experiment_id, user_id, variant) VALUES(#{experimentId}, #{userId}, #{variant})
